# working: evidence says whether a probe VERIFIED it or the code was only TRACED; a row whose action is test has no test yet.
# never built: no commit ever added a caller (pickaxe over src and include); removed on purpose: a named commit replaced the caller.
# owner: removing or wiring it is the owner's call (A64.md, second pass). Done means classified, not acted on.
